title: Choose the visual world for Nexus
question: The roll assigned the Engineering Computation Pad. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Engineering Computation Pad
options.lineage: pale-green engineering pads and numbered lab-notebook entries
options.thesis: The agent keeps a lab notebook: every step is a numbered, timed entry, and the graph beside it is the page it sketches on.
materials: blue pencil for what is live
options.viewport: Agent tab split 5/7: numbered entry log with thinking and tool calls on the left, live graph on the right where each node the agent reads is circled and stamped with its entry number.
options.risk: Grid paper can turn into costume if it leaks into controls; it must stay on grounds and rules only.

raised.raise: Each entry's bar length encodes its real duration, so slow steps are visible at a glance.
The agent's route is drawn on the graph, connecting entities in the order it reached them.
One live colour owns everything happening now: the active entry, the node being read, the progress rule.
The pad grid is the real layout armature: panels and rows snap to the same cell.
Real numbers at density: elapsed time, tool calls, nodes read, verified vs proposed, in tabular figures.

options.label: Transit Diagram
options.lineage: Vignelli and Beck schematic transit maps
options.thesis: The agent's reasoning is a journey: each tool call a station on its line, the graph a network map it rides across.
options.viewport: Split view: a vertical route line of stations (steps) beside the graph, the agent's path highlighted as a coloured line.
options.risk: Familiar: it is where most runs for a network product land, and force layouts fight the 45/90 discipline.

options.label: Midnight Transit Mural
options.lineage: enamel metro maps on midnight blue
options.thesis: The graph as a lit rail network at night; the chosen route burns brightest while the agent rides it.
options.viewport: Dark full-bleed network with the agent's route glowing station by station; trace docked left.
options.case: Holds product clarity (a path through a network) but a dark projected room loses legibility.
options.risk: Dark ground plus glowing lines drifts toward the neon AI-dashboard default.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: Steps as shaped blocks on a staff whose length is their duration.
options.viewport: Vertical staff of steps reading upward.
options.case: Engineers do not read dance notation; fuses poorly on identification.
options.kept: Duration encoded as length, now on every entry bar.
options.risk: Opaque to anyone who has not learned the notation.

options.label: Convention Circle Catalog
options.lineage: newsprint event catalogs with hall maps
options.thesis: Entities as coded cells, circled in pen with a route planned between them.
options.viewport: Packed grid of entity cells keyed to a map.
options.case: Charming but reads as fandom ephemera, not engineering.
options.kept: The planned route between circled items, now drawn on the graph.
options.risk: Density without hierarchy for a projected screen.

options.label: Metro Typographic Tiles
options.lineage: flat tile interfaces with giant cropped type
options.thesis: Type and colour fields as the whole interface.
options.viewport: Panorama of tiles, giant headings cropped off-canvas.
options.case: Tiles cannot carry a graph or a step-by-step trace clearly.
options.kept: One accent colour owns every live state.
options.risk: Style over legibility for reasoning traces.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The construction grid made visible as the design.
options.viewport: Visible grid with monumental gridded letterforms.
options.case: Poster-scale type competes with the trace for attention.
options.kept: The grid as a real layout armature, not decoration.
options.risk: Turns a working screen into a poster.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Dense numeric columns and barcodes as the surface.
options.viewport: Strobing barcode field with data columns.
options.case: Strobing and pure black hurt a projected demo; fuses poorly.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The AI-dashboard default: dark navy shell, glowing graph, chat panel docked right.
canonCard.viewport: Dark full graph with a floating chat drawer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other AI graph demo by design.
